nodes.label: Logo: Freiwillige Feuerwehr Gammelsdorf 150th Anniversary
nodes.description: Anniversary logo for the 150th jubilee of Freiwillige Feuerwehr Gammelsdorf (Volunteer Fire Department Gammelsdorf). Features a stylized orange-red flame on the left side wrapping around a heraldic shield. The shield is blue with a crossed lance/spear and an arrow in gold/yellow, with a golden sun-wheel or morning star emblem. To the right of the shield, the number '150' is displayed in bold red, followed by the text 'FREIWILLIGE FEUERWEHR' in dark gray and 'GAMMELSDORF' in bold black. Color palette: fire red/orange, royal blue (shield background), gold/yellow (heraldic elements), dark gray and black (text), white background.

nodes.label: Freiwillige Feuerwehr Gammelsdorf
nodes.description: Volunteer fire department located in Gammelsdorf, celebrating its 150th anniversary.

nodes.label: Heraldic Shield of Gammelsdorf
nodes.description: Blue heraldic shield bearing crossed golden lance and arrow, with a golden morning star or sun-wheel. Represents the municipal coat of arms of Gammelsdorf.
